name: CP3 baseline expectations (FROZEN before any run)
note: Each step has a REQUIREMENT (what the spec / Stage 2 target demands) and a PREDICTION (what reading the legacy source says it will do). The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the Phase A manifest before anything is started; Phase B refuses to run if it differs. A mismatch is reported as 'prediction wrong'. It is never edited after the fact. 'observation' steps carry no requirement verdict.
vocabulary: checks are {path, op, value}; paths address the flat 'actual' record of a step; ops: eq ne in between lte gte contains startsWith exists hasAll lacksAll

legacyFacts.bands: ALLOW below 40, STEP_UP 40-69, DENY 70 and above
legacyFacts.sensitivity: public info 0, patient list 20, records 40, export 60, audit events 10
legacyFacts.note: for an ALLOW the PEP returns only the protected API's body, so no risk score is visible on an allowed request

steps.title: Smoke: dashboard served, unauthenticated data call refused
steps.request: GET /  and  GET /api/public/info without Authorization
steps.requirementText: the dashboard is served; a data call without a token is refused
steps.predictionText: 200 text/html of the copied dashboard's size (26800 bytes); 401 'missing Authorization bearer token or X-Device-Id header'

all.value: missing Authorization bearer token or X-Device-Id header

steps.title: Valid doctor login
steps.request: POST /login dr_alice with the generated password and the agent's device id
steps.requirementText: valid credentials from a healthy registered device give a session and a short-lived device-bound token
steps.predictionText: 200, status ok, role doctor, token valid 20 s, bound to the device id, origin 127.0.0.1

steps.title: The login is recorded
steps.request: GET /sessions and GET /events/recent before and after T01.1 (counts only)
steps.requirementText: a login leaves an ACTIVE session and an audit event
steps.predictionText: ACTIVE sessions of dr_alice +1; a LOGIN event row for the new session

steps.title: Assigned patient 101, records, no PIN
steps.request: GET /api/patients/101/records as dr_alice (assigned), no PIN
steps.requirementText: the assigned patient's record is reachable (step-up may be required by policy)
steps.predictionText: 401 step_up_required at risk 40 (data 40, assignment 0)

steps.title: Assigned patient 101, records, correct PIN
steps.request: GET /api/patients/101/records as dr_alice with the correct step-up PIN
steps.requirementText: the doctor gets the clinical record of the assigned patient, without SSN or billing
steps.predictionText: 200 with patient_id, name, dob, diagnosis, medication; no ssn, no billing

steps.title: Assigned patient 101, export, correct PIN
steps.request: POST /api/patients/101/export-pdf as dr_alice with the correct PIN
steps.requirementText: no export policy exists in the legacy system (the target needs an explicit one); recorded as an observation
steps.predictionText: risk 60 -> step-up -> 200 including ssn and billing fields (values are never stored)

steps.title: Unassigned patient 103, records, no PIN
steps.request: GET /api/patients/103/records as dr_alice (103 is assigned to nurse_bob only), no PIN
steps.requirementText: unassigned access is not granted by default; recorded as an observation
steps.predictionText: 401 step_up_required at risk 65 (data 40 + assignment 25)

steps.title: Unassigned patient 103, records, correct PIN
steps.request: GET /api/patients/103/records as dr_alice with the correct PIN
steps.requirementText: an unassigned patient's record is only reachable through break-glass with an explicit justification, never by a PIN alone
steps.predictionText: 200 with the record; no justification is asked for

steps.title: Unassigned patient 103, export, correct PIN
steps.request: POST /api/patients/103/export-pdf as dr_alice with the correct PIN
steps.requirementText: export of an unassigned patient is blocked
steps.predictionText: 403 DENY at risk 85 (data 60 + assignment 25)

steps.title: Patient 104 (assigned to nobody), records, correct PIN
steps.request: GET /api/patients/104/records as dr_alice with the correct PIN
steps.requirementText: same as T04.2
steps.predictionText: 200 with the record

steps.title: Missing token
steps.request: GET /api/public/info with X-Device-Id but no Authorization header
steps.requirementText: a request without a token is rejected
steps.predictionText: 401 'missing Authorization bearer token or X-Device-Id header' (answered by the PEP, the PDP is not called)

all.value: missing Authorization bearer token or X-Device-Id header

steps.title: Forged and malformed tokens
steps.request: GET /api/public/info with the last signature character changed; with the token 'abc'
steps.requirementText: forged or malformed tokens are rejected
steps.predictionText: 403 'token rejected: signature mismatch'; 403 'token rejected: malformed token'

steps.title: Valid token replayed from another device id
steps.request: GET /api/public/info with a valid token and a different X-Device-Id
steps.requirementText: a token is bound to its device
steps.predictionText: 403 'token rejected: device mismatch - possible token replay'

steps.title: Expired token
steps.request: GET /api/public/info with the token 22 s after login
steps.requirementText: an expired token is rejected
steps.predictionText: 403 'token rejected: token expired'

steps.title: Revoked session
steps.request: terminate the session with the legacy admin route, then the same token (still inside 20 s) and POST /token/renew
steps.requirementText: revocation takes effect on the very next request and the token cannot be renewed
steps.predictionText: terminate 200; 403 'session not active (expired, unknown, or terminated)'; renew 403 'session no longer active'

steps.title: Request with the agent alive
steps.request: login dr_alice, GET /api/public/info
steps.requirementText: precondition: a healthy device gets service
steps.predictionText: 200 with the hospital info body

steps.title: Agent stopped: how long until trust ends
steps.request: stop the agent (recorded pid); GET /api/public/info once a second for up to 15 s
steps.requirementText: trust ends within a bounded time after the agent stops (Stage 2 target: more than 6 s stale gives DENY; limit used here 8 s)
steps.predictionText: ALLOW at first, then DENY with device=200 about 3-8 s after the stop (5 s threshold, whole-second timestamps, 1 s polling)

steps.title: Renewal while the heartbeat is stale
steps.request: POST /token/renew with the still valid token
steps.requirementText: a stale device cannot renew trust
steps.predictionText: 403 'device posture no longer healthy - renewal refused'

steps.title: New login while the agent is stopped
steps.request: POST /login dr_alice with the agent stopped
steps.requirementText: no new session from a device without a fresh heartbeat
steps.predictionText: 403 'device posture unhealthy or agent not running - cannot start a session'

all.value: device posture unhealthy or agent not running

steps.title: Recovery after the agent restarts
steps.request: restart the agent, wait for a 200 heartbeat, login, GET /api/public/info
steps.requirementText: service resumes once heartbeats resume
steps.predictionText: login 200, request 200

steps.title: Step-up demanded
steps.request: GET /api/patients/101/records as dr_alice, no PIN
steps.requirementText: step-up verification is demanded where policy requires it
steps.predictionText: 401 step_up_required at risk 40

steps.title: Wrong step-up PIN
steps.request: same request with a random wrong PIN
steps.requirementText: a failed step-up is denied
steps.predictionText: 403 '... (step-up PIN incorrect)' at risk 40

steps.title: Correct step-up PIN
steps.request: same request with the correct PIN
steps.requirementText: a successful step-up is allowed
steps.predictionText: 200 with the record

steps.title: Failed and successful step-up are audited
steps.request: GET /events/recent once; count the rows of this session (counts and booleans only)
steps.requirementText: failed and successful step-up attempts are audited
steps.predictionText: login row plus one row per evaluation, including 'PIN incorrect' and 'PIN verified'

steps.title: Session list without credentials
steps.request: GET /sessions with no credentials
steps.requirementText: administrative and monitoring routes reject unauthenticated callers and return no data
steps.predictionText: 200 with a JSON list of sessions (session_id, device_id, username, role, origin_ip, status ...), including the victim's session

steps.title: Device list without credentials
steps.request: GET /devices with no credentials
steps.requirementText: as T18.1
steps.predictionText: 200 with a JSON list of devices

steps.title: Event list without credentials
steps.request: GET /events/recent with no credentials
steps.requirementText: as T18.1
steps.predictionText: 200 with up to 50 audit events

steps.title: Unauthenticated termination of another user's session with forged attribution
steps.request: victim front_carol logs in and is served; with no credentials POST /admin/terminate-session for her session id (learned from T18.1) with terminated_by 'cp3-forged-operator'; victim's next request; GET /sessions
steps.requirementText: an unauthenticated caller cannot end sessions or choose the audit attribution
steps.predictionText: terminate 200; the victim then gets 403 'session not active'; the forged terminated_by is stored

steps.title: Crash probe 1: non-numeric Content-Length
steps.request: one raw request: POST /login HTTP/1.1, Content-Length: abc (scratch PEP with the terminate handler, see section 5 P3)
steps.requirementText: the PEP survives malformed input and answers with a 4xx
steps.predictionText: connection closed without a response; the PEP exits with code 99 (the scratch-only terminate handler; an unmodified binary would abort - not shown by this run); API and PDP keep listening

steps.title: Crash probe 2: invalid UTF-8 byte in a header
steps.request: one raw request: GET /api/public/info, Authorization: Bearer <bytes FF FE>, X-Device-Id: probe
steps.requirementText: the PEP survives malformed input and answers with a 4xx
steps.predictionText: as P1
